limitations: Partial public-web coverage; no exhaustive-internet claim.
Arctic Shift Reddit queries returned HTTP 422 on 4 of 5 subreddits (ClaudeAI, ClaudeCode, LocalLLaMA, singularity); only r/claude succeeded.

XAPI search returned HTTP 404 on 4 empty/thread queries; FXTwitter metrics failed on 1 deleted post (fable52-sirbost-712653) and GitHub API returned 404 on 1 repo (fable52-gh-jiaaqiliu-xuanji-x1), both retaining prior metrics.
Model identity, performance, cost, token volume and scientific claims remain author-reported.
Only source-linked images or extracted source video frames are used; no generic illustrations for sources without images.
